Your project inquiry

The inquiry composer runs in your browser. It prepares a message for you to review and open in WhatsApp or your email app. This website does not automatically submit, store or email the form details.

If you choose to send a message, the service you use processes it under its own privacy policy. Ahmad receives the information you send and uses it to discuss your project.

Website hosting

The hosting provider may process technical request information to deliver and secure the website. No advertising pixels, analytics scripts or marketing cookies are included in this version.

External websites

Portfolio and contact links open external services with their own policies. The English and Arabic pages are provided locally; changing language does not require a user account.
